notes.subject: אף
notes.rationale: nose/anger: 'heap up wrath' (KJV) vs 'set the face' (YLT) vs 'harbor resentment' (BSB); mi usim 'kros' — bel bilong kros.

notes.subject: bel nogut
notes.rationale: חנפי = soiled/impious; Tok Pisin 'ol man bilong bel nogut' i holim piksa bilong bel, i no 'hypocrite'.

notes.subject: כי אסרם
notes.rationale: 'in that He binds them' (taim Em i pasim ol) o 'bilong ol i pasim ol yet' — Em (Elohim) i pasim ol man nogut.

translation: Na ol man bilong bel nogut ol i putim kros; ol i no singaut long helpim taim Em i pasim ol.
